patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I Googled my symptoms and I am 100% dying. Heart's pounding, my fingers are tingling. This is the fourth time this month — the cardiologist already said my heart's fine. I'm not dying, right? ...Right?
presentation.triageNote: 31-year-old male, recurrent palpitations and finger tingling, his fourth episode this month, with a prior negative cardiac workup.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: Psych is the preferred destination for this medically stable behavioral-health presentation; the underlying clinical acuity is ESI 4.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is a recurrent episode of palpitations, tingling, and rapid breathing in a medically stable patient with a previously negative cardiac evaluation.
clinical.acuityReason: The recurrent pattern, normal oxygenation, absence of pain, and prior reassuring workup reduce immediate medical concern, although current safety and medical red flags still require screening.
teachingPoints: Rapid breathing can produce fingertip or perioral tingling through reduced carbon dioxide levels.
A recurrent anxiety pattern remains a diagnosis of exclusion, so new medical or safety concerns should still be screened.

possibleDiagnoses: Cardiac or metabolic cause if new findings emerge
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: After medical and safety screening, the patient could receive a calm environment, breathing coaching, and outpatient behavioral-health follow-up.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 31-year-old man in office clothes, tie loosened
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting on the edge of the chair, phone clutched in one hand
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 31-year-old man in office clothes with a loosened tie, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: perched on the edge of the chair, a phone clutched in one hand. Expression: frightened and overwhelmed, breathing fast — NOT gritted teeth. Clearly visible: rapid breathing, wide eyes, gripping his phone. Overall distressed but medically stable. No text, no logos.
